author: Silver Cymbal
description:
Lawn Cleanups & raking up leaves can be a LOT of work especially for bigger lots. Here I test the legendary Cyclone Rake to see if it really is worth it? This machine claims it can clear huge amounts of leaves & debris with as little effort as possible.

All links are NON-AFFILIATE

Want to learn more about Cyclone Rake? Download their Free Digital Info Kit: https://www.cyclonerake.com/free-digital-info-kit/ 

Cyclone Rake Commercial PRO (the unit featured): https://www.cyclonerake.com/cyclone-rake-commercial-pro-leaf-and-lawn-vacuum/ 

Estate Vacuum: https://www.cyclonerake.com/estate-vacuum-commercial-pro

I was loaned the Cyclone Rake for 4 weeks & I share my opinion about it in this video, I do NOT get to keep the equipment.
